hook: Jason Weston earned his PhD in machine learning in 2000 from Royal Holloway, University of London, completing his doctoral research at AT&T Research in Red Bank, New Jersey under Alex Gammerman, Volodya Vovk and Vladimir Vapnik. He then worked as a researcher at Biowulf Technologies before moving to the Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics in Tubingen and later NEC Labs America. In 2009 he joined Google as a research scientist in New York, and in 2014 he moved to Facebook AI Research, now Meta AI, where he has continued as a research scientist while also serving as a visiting research professor at NYU. That same year he introduced memory networks with Sumit Chopra and Antoine Bordes, a class of models that pair a neural network with an explicit, addressable memory component so a system can read and write facts needed to answer questions or hold a conversation over a long context. He also helped design the bAbI benchmark suite, giving researchers a controlled way to test whether models could handle reasoning tasks such as multi step inference and coreference.

timeline.impact: Began a research career in statistical learning theory under leading figures in the field including Vladimir Vapnik.

timeline.impact: Moved into large scale industrial machine learning research.

quick_facts: PhD in machine learning from Royal Holloway, University of London in 2000, completed at AT&T Research
Doctoral advisors included Vladimir Vapnik, co-inventor of the support vector machine
Introduced memory networks in 2014 with Sumit Chopra and Antoine Bordes
Helped design the bAbI benchmark suite for testing reasoning in language models
Research scientist at Meta AI, formerly Facebook AI Research, since 2014
Visiting research professor at New York University

achievements.title: Introduced memory networks
achievements.impact: Pairing neural networks with an explicit readable and writable memory gave models a way to reason over facts and long contexts, influencing later architectures for question answering and dialogue.

achievements.title: Co-designed the bAbI benchmark suite
achievements.impact: Provided a widely used set of synthetic reasoning tasks that let researchers diagnose specific weaknesses in language understanding models.

achievements.title: Advanced conversational AI research at scale
achievements.impact: His work on dialogue systems and preference optimization at Meta AI shaped approaches to building more knowledgeable and controllable conversational agents.
